messages:
raj: FYI nightly eval (INT8 calib profile v3) shows a sudden quality hit on summarization suite, +12% ROUGE-L drop and perplexity jump. failing rate jumped from 4% -> 22%. anyone else see this?

miguel: ugh. saw the alert. did the nightly job include the new per-tensor scale change?

raj: yeah, pipeline switched to the new `scale_clip_fix` in the calib pass. job id: nightly-eval/2026-08-02-03

eval-bot: nightly-eval started: nightly-eval/2026-08-02-03 ; model: rdx-7b-qint8-v3 ; profiles: int8-calib-v3 ; reg tests: summarization-suite, qa-suite.

elaine: quick repro I ran locally — same trend on a small sample. example prompt + outputs below.

elaine: ```
# prompt: news article -> short summary
Prompt: "A regional transit authority announced new fare changes today..."
Baseline (fp16): "Transit authority announced fare changes to simplify fares and improve service..."
INT8-calib-v3: "Fare change announced... officials are bananas... service canceled."
# tokens look jittery and hallucination-like.
```

sarah: thanks — that output smells like calibration over-scaling some layers -> higher entropy on top logits. did you capture token-wise entropy or KL vs fp16?

elaine: I dumped token entropy for the example: fp16 avg entropy 2.1 nats, int8-calib-v3 avg entropy 3.8 nats. attached a tiny log snippet.

elaine: ```
Layer  - mean_entropy(fp16) - mean_entropy(int8-v3)
layer_14 - 1.9 - 4.0
layer_19 - 2.0 - 3.9
output   - 2.1 - 3.8
```

miguel: OK that's helpful. hypothesis: the new `scale_clip_fix` reduces zero-point bias but inadvertently increases dynamic range for a few mid layers, causing softened softmax. two quick checks: 1) rerun calib with `--min-samples 4k` and 2) try `--per-channel-clip` off.

raj: can we also run the reprset for the failing prompts and collect top-5 token distributions? I want to see whether tail mass moved to weird tokens.

miguel: running now on a 500-sample reprset. command I used: `python tools/quant/repro_calib.py --model rdx-7b --profile int8-calib-v3 --reprset samples/summary-500.json --dump-entropy /tmp/rep.json`

eval-bot: job queued: quant-repr/1851237890 ; worker: qnode-7 ; ETA ~8m.

sarah: long term options: if `min-samples` helps, we add a nightly sweep to tune sample counts per-arch; otherwise fallback plan is to pin int8-profile to v2 for summarization-suite until we fix scaling heuristics. also check whether quantization noise correlates with token frequency buckets (rare tokens) — might need frequency-aware clipping. :eyes:

raj: action items: (1) miguel to finish reprset run and post entropy diff CSV (due in thread) (2) miguel/elaine to try `--min-samples 4k` and `--per-channel-clip false` and report metric deltas (3) if repro confirmed, prod rollback of int8-calib-v3 for summarization-suite by EOD. I'll open a rollback PR if we see >8% ROUGE-L regression persist.

miguel: will post results in ~10m. :thumbsup:

elaine: saving failing examples to `gs://redwood-evals/triage/1851234567/` — added a couple of low-confidence summarization cases for inspection.

raj: thanks — please ping me if reprset shows single-layer culprit, we can craft a quick per-layer override.

miguel: update: reprset run done, entropy diffs uploaded: `gs://redwood-evals/triage/1851234567/entropy_diff.csv` — preliminary: layer_14 and layer_19 stand out (delta +2.0 nats). trying `--min-samples 4k` now.

sarah: great. if `min-samples` reduces entropy spike, we should add an automated check: nightly-calib must not increase mean output entropy by >0.5 nats vs fp16 on summarization-suite.

raj: agreed. will draft an alert rule after we confirm.

miguel: `--min-samples 4k` run finished: ROUGE-L recovered from -12% -> -1.8% vs baseline. entropy deltas reduced to ~+0.3 nats. looks like under-sampling during calib was the root cause.

elaine: and `--per-channel-clip false` made it worse (ROUGE -18%). so per-channel clipping was helping — the fix in v3 likely changed clipping thresholds too aggressively.

raj: solid repro. i'll roll back the profile for summarization-suite and queue a follow-up to fix the `scale_clip_fix` implementation + add the nightly entropy guard. thanks all.
